create_mesh_manifold: create a Mesh manifold from vertex and face tensors with a chosen spectral metric
solve_geodesic_path: solve a geodesic path between two points on a mesh manifold using ODE integration
compute_mesh_distance: compute the spectral distance between two points on a mesh using diffusion or biharmonic metric
project_point_to_mesh: project arbitrary 3D points onto the closest location on a triangle mesh surface
plot_trimesh: plot a triangle mesh in 3D with optional vertex or face color mapping using matplotlib
